name: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, mildly sweet tomato and butter gravy.
instructions: Chop the tomatoes and onion and boil them together for 8 minutes then blend into a smooth puree.|Melt the butter in a pan and saute the minced garlic and ginger for 1 minute.|Add the puree and red chili powder and cook for 10 minutes until the gravy thickens.|Stir in the garam masala and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.|Add the paneer cubes and salt to taste and cook gently for 5 minutes.|Serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Paneer Tikka
description: Marinated paneer and vegetables cooked in a pan until lightly charred.
instructions: Mix the yogurt with garam masala and lemon juice then add grated ginger and minced garlic and salt.|Add the paneer cubes and chunks of onion and capsicum and coat everything well.|Rest the mixture for 15 minutes.|Thread the pieces onto skewers if you have them.|Heat a little oil in a pan and cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side until lightly charred.|Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Chana Masala
description: A hearty North Indian chickpea curry that tastes great with rice or roti.
instructions: Heat the oil and fry the cumin for 30 seconds.|Add chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until golden.|Add minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.|Add chopped tomato with red chili powder and garam masala and cook for 8 minutes until soft.|Add boiled chickpeas with 1 cup of water and simmer for 15 minutes mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy.|Add salt and finish with chopped coriander.

name: Poha
description: Light and fluffy flattened rice tempered with mustard seeds and peanuts.
instructions: Rinse the poha in a colander for 1 to 2 minutes until soft then drain well.|Heat the oil and add the mustard seeds until they pop then fry the peanuts for 1 minute.|Add chopped green chili onion and small potato cubes and cook covered for 8 minutes until the potato is tender.|Mix the turmeric and salt into the poha.|Add the poha to the pan and gently heat through for 2 minutes.|Finish with lemon juice and chopped coriander.

name: Masala Omelette
description: A quick spiced omelette with onion tomato and green chili.
instructions: Beat the eggs with turmeric and salt.|Stir in finely chopped onion tomato green chili and coriander.|Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.|Pour in the egg mixture and cook for 2 minutes until the base sets.|Flip carefully and cook for 1 more minute.|Serve hot with toast.

name: Chicken Curry
description: A classic home-style chicken curry with a thick onion and tomato gravy.
instructions: Heat the oil and cook sliced onion for 8 minutes until golden brown.|Add minced ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.|Add chopped tomato turmeric coriander powder and red chili powder and cook for 6 minutes until the oil separates.|Add the chicken pieces and whisked yogurt and stir for 5 minutes.|Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes adding a splash of water if needed until the chicken is cooked through.|Stir in garam masala and salt and serve with rice.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Paneer cubes in a smooth and mildly spiced spinach gravy.
instructions: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes then cool it and blend into a smooth puree.|Heat the oil and fry the cumin then cook chopped onion for 4 minutes.|Add minced garlic and ginger and then chopped tomato and cook for 4 minutes.|Add the spinach puree and garam masala and simmer for 5 minutes.|Add the paneer cubes and salt and cook for 3 minutes.|Stir in the cream and serve hot.

name: Aloo Gobi
description: A dry potato and cauliflower stir-fry seasoned with everyday Indian spices.
instructions: Heat the oil and fry the cumin for 30 seconds.|Add chopped onion and grated ginger and cook for 4 minutes.|Add chopped tomato turmeric and coriander powder and cook for 3 minutes.|Add potato cubes and cauliflower florets with salt and mix well.|Cover and cook on low heat for 15 to 18 minutes stirring now and then until tender.|Sprinkle with garam masala and serve.

name: Egg Curry
description: Hard-boiled eggs simmered in a spiced onion and tomato masala.
instructions: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes then cool and peel them.|Heat the oil and cook chopped onion for 6 minutes until golden.|Add minced ginger and garlic then chopped tomato and cook for 5 minutes.|Add turmeric coriander powder red chili powder and salt and cook for 1 minute.|Add 1 cup of water and simmer for 5 minutes.|Add the whole eggs and simmer for 5 minutes then stir in garam masala.

name: Suji Halwa
description: A warm and fragrant semolina pudding made with ghee and cardamom.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a pan and roast the cashews until light golden then remove them.|Add the semolina and roast on low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until fragrant and light golden.|Warm the milk with 1 cup of water and carefully pour it into the semolina while stirring because it will splutter.|Stir for 3 minutes until the mixture thickens.|Add the sugar and cardamom powder and cook for 3 minutes until the halwa leaves the sides of the pan.|Top with the roasted cashews and serve warm.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: A simple Roman pasta with garlic olive oil and chili.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente and keep 1 cup of the pasta water.|Warm the olive oil on low heat and cook thinly sliced garlic for 2 to 3 minutes until just golden.|Add the chili flakes and cook for 30 seconds.|Add the drained spaghetti and a splash of pasta water and toss for 1 minute.|Finish with chopped parsley and black pepper.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
description: Penne in a spicy tomato and garlic sauce.
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente then drain.|Heat the olive oil and cook minced garlic and chili flakes for 30 seconds.|Add chopped tomatoes and salt and simmer for 12 minutes until the sauce thickens.|Toss the pasta in the sauce for 1 minute.|Top with torn basil leaves.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
description: Pasta in a silky cream sauce with browned mushrooms and parmesan.
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente and keep half a cup of pasta water.|Melt the butter in a wide pan and cook sliced mushrooms for 6 to 7 minutes until browned.|Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.|Pour in the cream and simmer for 3 minutes.|Stir in grated parmesan and the pasta and loosen with pasta water if needed.|Serve with chopped parsley.

name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
description: Tender chicken slices over pasta coated in a creamy parmesan sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook in 1 tablespoon of butter for 6 minutes per side until cooked through then rest and slice it.|Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente then drain.|In the same pan melt the remaining butter and cook minced garlic for 30 seconds.|Add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes.|Stir in the parmesan until melted and season with pepper.|Toss in the pasta and top with the sliced chicken.

name: Quick Margherita Pizza
description: A simple pizza made on a ready-made base.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C.|Spread the tomato sauce over the pizza base leaving a small border.|Top with sliced mozzarella.|Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the cheese bubbles and the edges are golden.|Add fresh basil leaves and drizzle with olive oil before serving.

name: Tomato Bruschetta
description: Crisp toasted bread topped with a fresh tomato and basil mix.
instructions: Dice the tomatoes and mix with minced garlic torn basil olive oil balsamic vinegar and salt.|Slice the bread and toast it until golden and crisp.|Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toast just before serving.

name: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh tomato and mozzarella layered with basil.
instructions: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.|Arrange them on a plate in alternating layers.|Tuck basil leaves between the slices.|Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.

name: Affogato
description: Vanilla ice cream drowned in a shot of hot espresso.
instructions: Place a scoop or two of vanilla ice cream in a glass or small bowl.|Brew a shot of hot espresso.|Pour the espresso over the ice cream right before serving.|Grate a little dark chocolate on top.

name: Vegetable Quesadilla
description: A crisp tortilla filled with melted cheese and vegetables.
instructions: Melt half the butter in a pan and cook sliced capsicum onion and sweet corn for 4 minutes then remove them.|Place a tortilla in the pan and sprinkle with cheese.|Add the vegetables and more cheese and fold the tortilla in half.|Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.|Cut into wedges and serve.

name: Bean Burrito Bowl
description: Rice topped with spiced beans corn and fresh tomato salsa.
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet and keep it warm.|Heat the oil and fry the cumin then cook half the chopped onion for 3 minutes.|Add drained black beans and sweet corn with salt and warm through for 5 minutes.|Mix diced tomato the remaining onion coriander and lime juice for a quick salsa.|Fill bowls with rice then beans and top with the salsa.

name: Chicken Tacos
description: Spiced chicken in crunchy taco shells with fresh toppings.
instructions: Toss the chicken pieces with cumin paprika and salt.|Heat the oil and cook the chicken for 8 to 10 minutes until there is no pink inside.|Warm the taco shells in the oven for 3 minutes.|Slice the onion tomato and lettuce.|Fill the shells with chicken and vegetables and squeeze lime juice on top.

name: Guacamole
description: Creamy mashed avocado with lime and fresh herbs.
instructions: Mash the ripe avocados in a bowl leaving a few small chunks.|Stir in finely chopped tomato onion green chili and coriander.|Add lime juice and salt and mix gently.|Serve right away with tortilla chips.

name: Huevos Rancheros
description: Fried eggs on tortillas with a warm tomato salsa and beans.
instructions: Heat half the oil and cook chopped onion garlic and green chili for 3 minutes.|Add chopped tomato and salt and simmer for 10 minutes to make the salsa.|Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and warm the black beans.|Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set.|Place the tortillas on plates and top with beans then the egg then the salsa.

name: Cinnamon Churros
description: Crisp fried dough rolled in cinnamon sugar.
instructions: Bring 1 cup of water with the butter and a pinch of salt to a boil.|Add 1 cup of flour and stir quickly until a smooth dough forms then cool for 5 minutes.|Beat in the egg until smooth and spoon the dough into a piping bag with a star tip.|Heat the oil to about 175 C and pipe short lengths of dough into it.|Fry for 3 minutes per side until golden then drain on paper towels.|Roll in a mix of sugar and cinnamon and serve warm.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Stir-fried rice with colorful vegetables and soy sauce.
instructions: Use cold cooked rice because it fries better than fresh rice.|Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry minced garlic for 10 seconds.|Add diced carrot green beans and capsicum and stir-fry for 3 minutes.|Add the rice and soy sauce and toss for 3 minutes.|Stir in chopped green onion and serve.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles
description: Indo-Chinese stir-fried noodles with crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Boil the noodles until just tender then drain and toss with a little oil.|Heat the oil in a wok on high heat and stir-fry minced garlic for 10 seconds.|Add sliced cabbage carrot and capsicum and stir-fry for 3 minutes.|Add the noodles soy sauce vinegar and black pepper and toss for 2 minutes.|Top with chopped green onion.

name: Chicken Chow Mein
description: Stir-fried noodles with chicken and vegetables.
instructions: Slice the chicken thinly and mix with a little soy sauce and black pepper and rest for 10 minutes.|Boil the noodles until just tender then drain.|Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until cooked through then remove it.|Stir-fry minced garlic cabbage and carrot for 3 minutes.|Return the chicken and add the noodles and the remaining soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes.|Top with chopped green onion.

name: Mapo-Style Spicy Tofu
description: Soft tofu and mushrooms in a spicy savory sauce.
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes.|Heat the oil and cook minced garlic ginger and chili flakes for 30 seconds.|Add chopped mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes.|Add the soy sauce and half a cup of water then add the tofu and simmer gently for 5 minutes.|Mix the cornstarch with 1 tablespoon of cold water and stir it in for 1 minute until the sauce thickens.|Top with chopped green onion and serve with rice.

name: Egg Drop Soup
description: A light and silky soup with ribbons of egg.
instructions: Simmer the vegetable broth with grated ginger and soy sauce for 5 minutes.|Mix the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of cold water and stir it in until the soup thickens slightly.|Beat the eggs and pour them slowly into the soup in a thin stream while stirring gently.|Season with black pepper and top with chopped green onion.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
description: Crispy rolls filled with stir-fried vegetables.
instructions: Stir-fry shredded cabbage carrot and capsicum with minced garlic and soy sauce for 3 minutes and let the filling cool.|Mix 1 tablespoon of cornstarch with 1 tablespoon of water to make a paste.|Place a spoonful of filling on a wrapper then fold in the sides and roll tightly sealing the edge with the paste.|Heat oil for frying and cook the rolls for 3 to 4 minutes until golden.|Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Tangy and spicy fried rice topped with a fried egg.
instructions: Heat the oil and fry chopped kimchi for 3 minutes.|Add cold cooked rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3 minutes.|Fry an egg in a separate pan until the white is set.|Serve the rice topped with the egg then drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with chopped green onion.

name: Bibimbap
description: A rice bowl with seasoned vegetables a fried egg and spicy gochujang.
instructions: Cook the rice and keep it warm.|Blanch the spinach for 1 minute then squeeze dry and season with a little minced garlic sesame oil and soy sauce.|Stir-fry sliced carrot and then sliced mushrooms separately in a little sesame oil for 3 minutes each.|Slice the cucumber and fry the eggs.|Place the rice in bowls and arrange the vegetables and the egg on top.|Add a spoonful of gochujang and mix everything before eating.

name: Korean Fried Chicken
description: Extra crunchy double-fried chicken tossed in a sweet and spicy glaze.
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season with minced garlic ginger and salt.|Mix the flour and cornstarch with enough cold water to make a thin batter and coat the chicken.|Heat the oil to about 170 C and fry the chicken in batches for 8 minutes then rest for 5 minutes.|Fry again for 3 minutes until very crisp.|Simmer the gochujang soy sauce and honey in a pan for 2 minutes.|Toss the chicken in the glaze and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Tteokbokki
description: Chewy rice cakes in a spicy sweet gochujang sauce.
instructions: Soak the rice cakes in water for 10 minutes if they are hard.|Simmer the vegetable broth with gochujang soy sauce sugar and minced garlic for 5 minutes.|Add the rice cakes and cook for 8 to 10 minutes stirring often until soft and the sauce thickens.|Top with chopped green onion.

name: Japchae
description: Glass noodles stir-fried with vegetables in a sweet soy sesame sauce.
instructions: Boil the glass noodles for 6 minutes then drain and cut them into shorter lengths.|Blanch the spinach for 1 minute and squeeze it dry.|Stir-fry sliced onion carrot and mushroom separately with a little minced garlic for 3 minutes each.|Toss the noodles and vegetables with soy sauce sugar and sesame oil.|Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Vegetarian Miso Soup
description: A light Japanese soup with tofu and spinach.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth until hot but not boiling.|Add cubed tofu and spinach and cook for 2 minutes.|Turn off the heat and dissolve the miso paste in a ladle of broth before stirring it into the pot.|Do not boil the soup after adding the miso.|Top with chopped green onion.

name: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Glazed chicken in a sweet and savory soy sauce served over rice.
instructions: Cook the rice and keep it warm.|Mix the soy sauce honey minced garlic and grated ginger to make the sauce.|Heat the oil and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side until browned.|Pour in the sauce and simmer for 3 minutes turning the chicken until glazed and cooked through.|Slice the chicken and serve over rice with sesame seeds.

name: Vegetable Tempura
description: Light and crispy battered vegetables.
instructions: Cut the vegetables into thin slices.|Beat the egg with 1 cup of ice-cold water then add the flour and cornstarch and mix lightly because a few lumps are fine.|Heat the oil to about 170 C.|Dip the vegetables in the batter and fry for 2 to 3 minutes until pale golden and crisp.|Drain on a rack or paper towels and serve with soy sauce.

name: Avocado Onigiri
description: Hand-formed rice triangles with a creamy avocado filling.
instructions: Cook short-grain rice and let it cool slightly.|Mash the avocado with a few drops of soy sauce.|Wet your hands with salted water and take a handful of rice.|Press a spoonful of avocado into the center and cover it with more rice.|Shape into a triangle and wrap a strip of nori around the base.|Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Tamagoyaki
description: A rolled Japanese omelette that is slightly sweet.
instructions: Beat the eggs with the soy sauce sugar and chopped green onion.|Lightly oil a small non-stick pan over medium-low heat.|Pour in a thin layer of egg and roll it up when it is almost set.|Push the roll to one side and oil the pan again.|Pour in more egg and lift the roll so the egg flows underneath then roll again.|Repeat until the egg is used then slice and serve.

name: Dorayaki
description: Fluffy pancakes sandwiched with sweet red bean paste.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the sugar and honey until combined then add the milk.|Mix the flour with the baking powder and fold it in then rest the batter for 10 minutes.|Heat a lightly oiled pan on low heat and pour in small rounds of batter.|Cook until bubbles appear then flip and cook for 1 minute.|Sandwich two pancakes together with a spoonful of red bean paste.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: A crisp golden sandwich with melted cheese.
instructions: Spread butter on one side of each bread slice.|Place the cheese between two slices with the buttered sides facing out.|Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
description: Soft homemade pancakes served with maple syrup.
instructions: Whisk the flour sugar baking powder and a pinch of salt in a bowl.|In another bowl whisk the egg milk and melted butter.|Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture and stir just until combined.|Heat a lightly buttered pan and pour in about a quarter cup of batter per pancake.|Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles form then flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.|Serve with maple syrup.

name: French Toast
description: Golden bread slices soaked in cinnamon custard.
instructions: Whisk the egg milk sugar and cinnamon in a shallow dish.|Dip each bread slice for about 10 seconds per side.|Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.|Cook the bread for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.|Serve warm.

name: Herb Grilled Chicken with Vegetables
description: Juicy lemon and herb chicken served with grilled vegetables.
instructions: Mix the chicken with half the olive oil minced garlic lemon juice oregano black pepper and salt and rest for 10 minutes.|Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat.|Cook the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes per side until there is no pink inside then rest for 5 minutes.|Toss the sliced zucchini capsicum and onion with the remaining olive oil and grill for 4 to 5 minutes.|Serve the chicken with the vegetables.

name: Classic Tomato Soup
description: A simple smooth tomato soup.
instructions: Heat the olive oil and cook chopped onion for 4 minutes then add minced garlic for 1 minute.|Add chopped tomatoes and 2 cups of water and simmer for 15 minutes.|Blend until smooth.|Return to the pot and add basil black pepper and salt then heat through for 2 minutes.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: A single-serve chocolate cake made in the microwave.
instructions: In a large microwave-safe mug mix the flour cocoa powder sugar and baking powder.|Add the egg milk and melted butter and stir until smooth.|Microwave for 70 to 90 seconds until the cake is set.|Let it cool for 1 minute before eating.

name: Fresh Fruit Salad
description: A light fruit bowl with lemon and mint.
instructions: Wash and chop the apple and banana and separate the orange into segments.|Halve the grapes.|Toss everything with lemon juice to stop the fruit browning.|Add chopped mint and chill for 10 minutes if you like.
